web-guide-idea-86.audience: Music learners who benefit from a regular guided practice.
web-guide-idea-86.offer: Lead focused exercises within your teaching experience. Structure turns so individual feedback remains possible.
web-guide-idea-86.steps.0: Set the exercise and explain its purpose.
web-guide-idea-86.steps.1: Demonstrate and let participants practise in suitable turns.
web-guide-idea-86.steps.2: Review common difficulties and set a small routine.
web-guide-idea-86.equipment: A phone, clear audio and the relevant instrument if used. Plan around call latency instead of promising perfectly synchronised singing.
web-guide-idea-86.returnReason: Use a gradual progression of exercises and revisit foundations.
web-guide-idea-86.promotion: Share a short exercise and state the required musical level.
